source_exact_sentence: Základ tvoří micelární kasein – pomalý protein, který se vstřebává až 7 hodin a zajišťuje dlouhodobý pocit sytosti.

target_contexts.sk: Základ tvorí micelárny kazeín – pomalý proteín, ktorý sa vstrebáva až 7 hodín a zaisťuje dlhodobý pocit sýtosti. Bráni večerným chutiam aj odbúravaniu svalovej hmoty. Dopĺňajú ho kolagénové peptidy typu I , ktoré chránia kĺby, šľachy a prispievajú k zdravému vzhľadu pleti. Súčasťou je aj MCT olej z kokosu – rýchly zdroj energie, ktorý sa v tele nespráva ako zásobný tuk.
target_contexts.en: The foundation is micellar casein – a slow protein that is absorbed over up to 7 hours and provides long-lasting satiety. It prevents evening cravings and muscle breakdown. It is complemented by type I collagen peptides , which protect joints and tendons and contribute to healthy-looking skin. The formula also includes MCT oil from coconut – a quick source of energy that does not behave like stored fat in the body.
target_contexts.de: Die Grundlage bildet mizellares Kasein – ein langsam verfügbares Protein, das über bis zu 7 Stunden aufgenommen wird und für ein lang anhaltendes Sättigungsgefühl sorgt. Es verhindert abendliche Heißhungerattacken und den Abbau von Muskelmasse. Ergänzt wird es durch Kollagenpeptide vom Typ I , die Gelenke und Sehnen schützen und zu einem gesunden Hautbild beitragen. Ebenfalls enthalten ist MCT-Öl aus Kokos – eine schnelle Energiequelle, die sich im Körper nicht wie Speicherfett verhält.

target_contexts.en: One of the most clinically validated probiotic cultures – Bacillus coagulans MTCC 5856 – which is resistant to stomach acid and acts exactly where it is needed: in the intestines. Each serving contains 8,9 billion CFU that restore the balance of the gut microbiota, support healthy digestion and improve nutrient absorption from food. A strong, healthy gut = faster metabolism, stronger immunity and less heaviness after meals. Probiotics also have a positive effect on mood and overall wellbeing, something you will particularly appreciate during weight loss.

target_contexts.en: A unique complex of seven digestive enzymes (amylase, lactase, protease, lipase, cellulase, bromelain and papain) that helps the body process proteins, fats and carbohydrates more efficiently. Bromelain from pineapple and papain from papaya also contribute to natural fat burning and faster muscle recovery after physical activity. OPTI7DIGEST® therefore supports not only weight loss but also overall digestive comfort and vitality.
